safety.fixtures: Opaque nonexecutable checkpoints/tokenizer/JAR and synthetic corpus/development/holdouts only.
profileExecutionInstrumentation: All Popen calls intercepted and blocked.
Only constructor java-version probes answered with a synthetic CompletedProcess.
Holdout scoring intercepted; ordinary scoring validates cached synthetic receipts.
Cached-final race uses tracing to change only a synthetic peer-child file after the real cache read.
Only BASE_SHA, TOKENIZER_SHA, HOLDOUT_SHA, CORE_HOLDOUT_SHA and CORE_JAR_SHA rebound to synthetic content.
safety.profilePositiveControls: Both valid budget targets reach the real central training dispatcher and blocked Popen. Both profiles reach the synthetic holdout boundary only after a valid two-child freeze.
safety.limits: This validates orchestration behavior against representative evidence, not model-format decoding, model quality, actual hardware latency, memory use or Android execution.

evidenceNotes: Compact case records are copied from completed raw reports, with generated fixture path prefixes replaced by <synthetic-fixture> and events reduced to event kinds. Raw report digests are retained. Pass outcomes were not recomputed or invented.
